text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- After Tunisia called on France to respect Tunisian immigrants' dignity, France says it welcomes legal Tunisian residents.
- Tunisia's exports of spare parts amounted to 220 million dinars in 1995.
- Trade talks between Tunisia and the Palestinian Authority.
- Speaker of parliament Habib Boulares arrives in Tripoli to represent President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali at the Libyan revolution anniversary celebrations.
